fard_habits.title: Fajr Prayer
fard_habits.ayah_reference: Quran 17:78 - Establish prayer at the decline of the sun

fard_habits.title: Dhuhr Prayer
fard_habits.ayah_reference: Quran 4:103 - Indeed, prayer has been decreed upon the believers

fard_habits.title: Asr Prayer
fard_habits.description: Pray 4 obligatory rakaat in the afternoon
fard_habits.ayah_reference: Quran 2:238 - Maintain with care the prayers and the middle prayer

fard_habits.title: Maghrib Prayer
fard_habits.ayah_reference: Quran 11:114 - Establish prayer at the two ends of the day

fard_habits.title: Isha Prayer
fard_habits.ayah_reference: Quran 20:130 - Glorify the praises of your Lord before sunrise and sunset

sunnah_habits.title: Fajr Sunnah Prayer
sunnah_habits.ayah_reference: Hadith - Two rak'ahs before Fajr are better than the world and everything in it

sunnah_habits.title: Dhuhr Sunnah Prayer
sunnah_habits.ayah_reference: Hadith - Whoever prays 4 before Dhuhr and 4 after, Allah will forbid the Fire for him

sunnah_habits.title: Morning Athkar
sunnah_habits.ayah_reference: Hadith - Remember Allah in the morning and evening

sunnah_habits.title: Evening Athkar
sunnah_habits.ayah_reference: Quran 33:41-42 - O you who believe! Remember Allah with much remembrance

sunnah_habits.title: Daily Quran Reading
sunnah_habits.description: Read and reflect on the Quran daily
sunnah_habits.ayah_reference: Quran 17:78 - Recite the Quran at dawn. Indeed, recitation at dawn is witnessed

sunnah_habits.title: Night Prayer (Qiyam)
sunnah_habits.description: Pray voluntary prayers during the night
sunnah_habits.ayah_reference: Quran 17:79 - And during the night wake up for prayer as extra worship

sunnah_habits.title: Duha Prayer
sunnah_habits.ayah_reference: Hadith - Prayer of the forenoon brings immense blessings

sunnah_habits.title: Tahajjud Prayer
sunnah_habits.description: Pray in the last third of the night
sunnah_habits.ayah_reference: Quran 51:17-18 - They used to sleep little at night and seek forgiveness before dawn
